Lauren / Sean — draft notes below (pulled from security & legal). Markers where Legal needs to redline are flagged. I attached the compliance one-pager and the SOC2 report stub.

Compliance summary (one-pager):
- SOC 2 Type II report covering production inference runtime and control plane (period: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30). Controls: change mgmt, incident response, encryption at rest/in transit, privileged access.
- Penetration testing: annual external pentest (last completed 2026-03), quarterly internal vuln scans. Results summary: no critical findings; 4 medium remediations in progress (remediation ETA: 2026-10-15).
- Data residency: Hosted API data processed in regional clusters; Dedicated/Private deployments support customer-managed VPC and on-prem options. We can supply a data flow diagram for specific regions upon request.
- Certifications: SOC2 Type II report attached (redacted), ISO27001 scope in progress (target Q1 2027).

Legal flags for contracting:
- Indemnity: standard mutual indemnities requested; legal would prefer carveouts for third-party open model licenses — request guidance from CloudCo on their baseline.
- Data retention: propose customer-controlled retention plus audit logging; Redwood needs an exception process for law enforcement requests (we can provide template).
- SLAs: Redwood offers tiered SLAs under Dedicated plans; Hosted API provides best-effort uptime with credits for outages — we can map to marketplace listing tiers.

Attachments included:
- SOC2-2025-Redwood-Inference.pdf (redacted)
- Compliance_OnePager_CloudCo.pdf

If this looks good I'll move to final PDF. Sean — anything to add on pricing/SKU?

Thanks,

Hi Marta,

Thanks for the RFI and timeline. Please find attached our consolidated response PDF and an onboarding timeline spreadsheet. Key highlights below for the board: 

- Commercial model: Redwood offers usage-based hosted pricing (per-token generation + embeddings) and Reserved/Dedicated committed capacity SKUs for customers requiring predictable throughput. For marketplace private offers we can map Dedicated SKUs to a monthly reserved capacity SKU (example mapping included in the attachment). We are flexible on bill-to vs bill-through; recommend bill-through for seamless end-customer billing in AWS Marketplace with a private-offer wedge.

- Contracting & compliance: Enclosed SOC2 Type II report (redacted), details on data residency and private deployment options, and a list of legal assumptions. We request standard mutual indemnities; any marketplace-specific indemnity asks from CloudCo please flag.

- Technical integration: We support metering endpoints and usage logs export for marketplace billing reconciliation; entitlement mapping is provided as a CSV template inside the PDF. Provisioning for Dedicated instances can be orchestrated via APIs and we provide onboarding runbooks.

- Timeline: We can supply all artifacts for a standard listing in ~3 weeks (assuming legal turnaround <5 business days after submission). If CloudCo requires additional in-person/security reviews, add 1-2 weeks.

Attachments:
- Redwood_RFI_Responses_CloudCo_20261005.pdf (contains section-by-section Q&A, SKU mapping table, and CSV template)
- Marketplace_Onboarding_Timeline.xlsx
- SOC2-2025-Redwood-Inference.pdf (redacted)

Point of contact for procurement: Lauren Bishop, lauren_bishop@redwood.com. For technical onboarding: Sean Gallagher, sean_gallagher@redwood.com. For compliance artifacts: Hannah Schmitt, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com.

Looking forward to next steps — happy to jump on a quick call with the marketplace team if helpful.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
